sources.title: Justice Ministry: Law No. 6 of 1987 on entry, residence and exit of foreigners
sources.officialityEvidence: Libya’s Ministry of Justice publishes the full text of Law No. 6 of 1987 on aladel.gov.ly. The live law sets the valid-visa baseline, an Arab-national personal-ID route, registration, purpose, carrier and international-agreement exceptions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A foreigner may enter ... if holding a valid visa ... on a valid passport.

sources.title: Libyan News Agency: national E-VISA LIBYA platform activation
sources.officialityEvidence: The state Libyan News Agency reports the 29 June 2026 Government circular starting official operation of Wafed and E-VISA LIBYA as the national platforms for electronic visas and foreigner entry and residence management.
sources.supportingExcerpt: E-VISA LIBYA ... the approved national platform for managing electronic visas.

sources.title: Libyan News Agency: new E-Visa channels replace prior electronic-visa categories
sources.officialityEvidence: The state Libyan News Agency reports the 29 June 2026 Government meeting on the new Wafed and E-Visa channels. It says all previous electronic-visa types and categories stopped, while publishing no nationality eligibility schedule for the new channels.
sources.supportingExcerpt: إيقاف العمل بجميع أنواع وتصنيفات التأشيرات الإلكترونية السابقة

sources.title: Libyan News Agency: temporary suspension of airport and air-border visas on arrival
sources.officialityEvidence: The state Libyan News Agency reports the Government circular of 11 June 2026 stopping visas issued on arrival at airports and air-border crossings until its review and procedures are completed.
sources.supportingExcerpt: temporarily suspending visas granted on arrival through airports and air border crossings.

sources.title: Libyan News Agency: Jordanian electronic or arrival entry-visa decision
sources.officialityEvidence: The state Libyan News Agency records the 11 December 2024 statement of the Libyan Embassy in Jordan about a Prime Minister decision for Jordanian electronic or border and airport entry-visa acquisition.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Jordanian citizens may obtain an entry visa through approved electronic-visa sites or on arrival.

sources.title: Libyan Consulate General in Manchester: visitor visa application
sources.officialityEvidence: The Libyan Consulate General publishes this 30 January 2025 visitor, business and family visa workflow on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs missions domain. It requires a Tripoli Passport and Immigration referral note and a physical-passport application.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A visa referral note ... issued by the Passport and Immigration Office in Tripoli.
